annotations.title: Explain Why a Rule Did or Didn't Alert

description: Why did (or didn't) this rule alert on this address? Checks, in a time window: the rule's status, mode, apps and environments; its runs and what each did with the address (notified, throttled, already blocked, trusted, dismissed); the per-address throttle; blocks on the address and the rule that made them; trusted and allowlist entries; notifications; and the address's requests, replayed through an instant rule's conditions. Returns ordered findings and a one-line verdict, e.g. "Detected at 15:06:31 but not notified: 203.0.113.50 was already blocked by instant rule X".

ip.description: The address to explain (IPv4 or IPv6).

since.description: Window start: 30m, 1h (default), 2d or an ISO date; at most 7 days.
